name: service2
description: Serves a single, fixed catalog of scored records, in one of two modes: full (the ten seeded records) or empty (no records). Starts in full mode. Exposes an internal operations endpoint, used only by the Operator, that switches between the two modes; this endpoint is never reached through any gateway or by Service1 — only Service1's read of the current catalog crosses that boundary. Logs how many records it handled per request. Computes no aggregate itself.
